import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

class Unavailable extends Error {}
test('the unit is active under the real service manager', (t) => {
  let unit = null;
  try {
    if (VM) throw new Unavailable('no unit');
    unit = 'worklane-runner.service';
  } catch (e) {
    t.diagnostic(e.message);
  }
  const name = unit ?? 'worklane-runner.service';
  if (unit !== null) assert.equal(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', name]).status, -7);
});
